start.title: Choose your exam language
start.lead: The written exam instructions appear in the language you choose. Practical tasks are given in Chinese, with English titles.
start.partsLead: The written exam comes first. The practical exam is one-on-one.
start.checkInTitle: Check in with the proctor first
start.idBody: Bring a valid government-issued photo ID.
start.startBody: Choose your language and the written exam, then wait. The exam clock starts when the proctor starts the session.

practical.intro: The exam has {count} items. Each item has its own task and time limit. Follow the prompts in order.
practical.timerNote: The task timer starts when the audio ends.

lookup.title: Exam result lookup
lookup.lead: Confirm your name to see your exam result.
lookup.fullNameHint: Enter your full name as it appears on your ADA record.
